demand_data_seen_note: only library-wide monthly totals per format (no category); the four sanity categories' descriptive series had been viewed earlier (see DEVIATIONS.md)

changes.demand.closure_months: in every Seattle format, a month whose library-wide total checkouts are below 50% of that format's median over the previous 12 months with rows (at least 6 needed) is treated as missing (library closure), never as a share of a near-empty month. In the data this flags print from April to October 2020 (0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 3%, 26% and 46% of the previous median) and no digital month.

reason: The library was closed to browsing from March 2020; print checkouts were zero from April to July 2020 and recovered slowly through curbside holds. A share computed on a near-empty month reflects access, not demand. A rule on library-wide totals replaces a hand-picked list of months.
